title: Software Engineering Senior Software Test Engineer Professional No City, BR
description:
A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe.

You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio; including Software and Red Hat.

Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in ground breaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your role and responsibilities

The Sr. Software Test Engineer verifies software products and systems to ensure they are functioning as described in the business requirements and design documents associated with the product or system.

  • Developand execute exploratory, manual and automated tests in order to ensure product quality.
  • Analyzeproduct specs, decompose complicated software systems, and design strategies to test these systems.
  • Workas an Agile team member participating in backlog grooming, sprint planning and task estimation.
  • Provide metrics upon execution of smoke and regression suites to establish baselines and track quality and efficiency improvements over time.
  • Ensure code quality, leveragability, scalability (performance & scale tests), maintainability (cyclomatic complexity), and product integration quality.
  • Communicate software testing and automation best practices with team; including new and emerging technologies.
Required education

Bachelor's Degree

Preferred education

Bachelor's Degree

Required technical and professional expertise

  • Test automation engineering experience with Selenium, Postman, Cypress and JMeter testing tools.
  • Proficiency developing/consuming/testing REST APIs including tooling for documentation (Swagger/Postman)
  • Experinece in testing data persistence systems using both SQL and NoSQL DBMS. (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, Dynamo)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeleines with Jenkins or AzureDevOps.
  • Proven experience working with the following technologies or their equivalents: Angular, Application Performance Management, Data analysis and visualization tools such as Kibana, PowerBI, Tableau, or Quicksight, AWS Cloud development knowledge is a plus, Data Science: Machine Leanring / Artificial Intelligence.
  • Experience with developing both front-end and back-end automation tests.
  • Understanding of security best practices for web development.
  • Broad knowledge and experience in testing principles, practices, tools and techniques.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills sufficient to effectively convey moderately complex information and concepts to customers and peers of varying technical ability.
Preferred technical and professional experience
  • Passion for finding problems with software, figuring out solutions, and helping ensure they never happen again.
  • Willingness to read product specs and take it upon yourself to fill in the gaps.
  • Strong technical aptitude and experience with the software tools and techniques used in software development and automated testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into test strategy and test cases.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to get work done through others.
  • Must be motivated; a self-starter, results oriented individual with a successful track record.
  • Ability to define testing tasks and provide estimates in agile development environment for integration and end-to-end quality.
  • Effective time management, ability to plan and prioritize work effectively.
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Ability to present ideas and document artifacts to business, technology and executive audiences.
ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT

IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.

YOUR LIFE @ IBM

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Being an IBMer means you’ll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you’ll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.

Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. They are trusted to provide on-going feedback to help other IBMers grow, as well as collaborate with colleagues keeping in mind a team focused approach to include different perspectives to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers. The courage our IBMers have to make critical decisions everyday is essential to IBM becoming the catalyst for progress, always embracing challenges with resources they have to hand, a can-do attitude and always striving for an outcome focused approach within everything that they do.

Are you ready to be an IBMer?

ABOUT IBM

IBM’s greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason and science, we can improve business, society and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world.

Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we’re also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 50 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business.

At IBM, we pride ourselves on being an early adopter of artificial intelligence, quantum computing and blockchain. Now it’s time for you to join us on our journey to being a responsible technology innovator and a force for good in the world.

IBM is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualifiedapplicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race,color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexualorientation, national origin, caste, genetics, pregnancy, disability,neurodivergence, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. IBM is alsocommitted to compliance with all fair employment practices regardingcitizenship and immigration status.

OTHER RELEVANT JOB DETAILS

description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI) role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Partner Sales Director to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Partner Sales Director will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will own the strategy, the sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with the GSI and will animate many customer workshops, sales events, public presentations and executive engagements.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
  • Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
  • Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Atividades:

  1. Compreensão do Negócio: Entender objetivos, estratégia e processos do negócio para alinhar soluções de TI ao planejamento estratégico e às necessidades do negócio.
  2. Comunicação Efetiva: Comunicar-se claramente com colegas, clientes internos e externos, garantindo alinhamento das soluções tecnológicas com os objetivos do negócio, além de elaborar relatórios e apresentações.

  7. Resolução de Problemas: Identificar e resolver problemas de forma eficiente.
  8. Negociação e Facilitação: Negociar com áreas internas, fornecedores e stakeholders, atuando como facilitador.
  9. Pensamento Analítico: Analisar dados e tendências para tomadas de decisão.
  10. Adaptabilidade: Adaptar-se rapidamente a novas tecnologias e tendências.
Gestão de Stakeholders:
  • Experiência: Gerenciar demandas de tecnologia, elaborar planos, cronogramas, gerenciar riscos e pessoas, com conhecimento sobre mercado de commodities e distribuição de combustíveis (diferencial).
  • Soft Skills: Comunicação eficaz, relacionamento interpessoal, negociação, facilitação e foco em resultados.

  • Educação: Graduação completa.

description:
Job description

Sua missão será atuar na área de Planejamento.



Main responsibilities

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Responsável pela gestão da equipe de monitoramento das entregas de SP e ES buscando manter em níveis controlados os KPIs de retorno, ocupação, jornada planejada x realizada.
  • Monitoramento da carteira e montagem da estratégia de entrega considerando as janelas de entrega e a capacidade logística, atuando como Torre de controle.
  • Gestão de NPS com tratativas e acompanhamentos necessários visando evoluir com o nível de serviço das unidades.
  • Analisar a carteira de clientes através das informações geradas no SAP diariamente e montar a melhor estratégia para escoar os pedidos de SMS.
  • Acompanhar diariamente as rupturas de estoque e interagir com as áreas de Supply, Armazém e Planejamento de Rota em busca de redução. (Reunião de indisponibilidade).
  • Manter os níveis de Retorno, Ocupação e ociosidade dentro das metas estabelecidas.
  • Controlar os indicadores de eficiência, execução e nível de serviço,bem como realizar atividades que garantam a manutenção desses indicadores.
  • Planificar as incidências de apontamentos de Customer Gauge (NPS) em busca de direcionar e melhorar a percepção do cliente quanto a serviço de entrega Andina BR.
  • Interagir com as áreas Vendas, Logística, Industria, Marketing, Call Center e Financeiro com o objetivo de garantir o Nível de Serviço e atendimento aos clientes internos e externos.
  • Planificar o tempo de retenção dos veículos nos clientes de responsabilidade da área e buscar redução ou manutenção do TME.


Requirements and skills

O que você precisa:

Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência em monitoramento de entregas, gestão de equipes e gestão de NPS;

Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel avançado);

Conhecimento em Power BI (avançado) para criação de relatórios;

Desejável conhecimento no sistema SAP;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Jacarepaguá no horário de 08:00-16:20/6x1 Seg-Sáb - Modelo de trabalho 100% presencial.



Additional information

Na Coca-Cola Andina Brasil , nada é tão importante quanto os nossos colaboradores; por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios que permite uma vida mais saudável e completa. Venha conhecer como fazemos a magia acontecer para você:

Sua saúde é nossa prioridade! Por isso, oferecemos Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida (conforme elegibilidade ). Além disso, contamos com um Ambulatório Multiprofissional que dispõe de serviços médicos, enfermagem e odontologia próprios (exclusivo nas unidades JPA e RP). Com o suporte de uma equipe especializada da operadora de saúde, dispomos de programas para acompanhamento de doenças crônicas.

E não é só isso; pensando no bem-estar físico, psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico, seu e de toda sua família disponibilizamos o Gympass e o Pack para Você, extensivo a dependentes .

Para dar aquele gás, oferecemos Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição (conforme elegibilidade ). Se você trabalhar em uma das nossas fábricas, temos restaurante .

Para dar um refresco no início do ano e deixar a criançada animada, oferecemos Kit Escolar (conforme elegibilidade).

Para refrescar momentos importantes, temos descontos com aquele gás, Venda ao Colaborador .

Vale Transporte opcional, de acordo com o modelo de trabalho de cada vaga.

Participação nos Resultados da Cia para todos.

Gostamos de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento; aqui, temos diversas iniciativas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento , como Portal do Conhecimento , parcerias com instituições de ensino, entre outras.

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

A Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pelaMOVIDA são afirmativos,inclusivos e não discriminatórios.

  • Acompanhamento e realização de tratativas referente a todos os veículos em manutenção. (Contato com fornecedores, recebimento de orçamentos, lançamento em sistema, contato com condutores e gestores para informar status).
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento das infrações de trânsito cometidas pelos condutores (Extração de relatórios no portal de multas, envio de links ao cliente, atualização de e-mails atrelados as placas da frota.
  • Liberação de veículos reservas.
  • Controle e solicitação de documentos aos condutores que tiverem envolvimento de sinistros e acidentes de trânsito.
  • Contato com condutores terceiros, para explicação dos procedimentos internos da Movida e atualização de status.
  • Contato direto com as áreas internas responsáveis nas tratativas solicitadas pelo cliente.
  • Recebimento de medições de locação e extras, para análise e repasse ao cliente.
  • Experiência com rotinas administrativas e múltiplas demandas
  • Experiência com gestão de frotas é um diferencial
  • Conhecimento básico em manutenção de veículos é um diferencial.
  • Ensino Médio completo

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

  • LIGADO EM VOCÊ: Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto.
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas + Kit nascimento para recém-mamães e recém-papais.
  • Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar para os filhos da nossa gente.
  • Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar.
  • Pela Universidade MOVIDA , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira.
  • Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos , ainda tem um evento mega especial.
  • Cantinho da Mamãe: O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno. No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.

Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S.A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. title: Senior Carbon Technical Manager
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - Brazil, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, or Costa Rica

Amid growing consensus that the protection, restoration, and improved management of ecosystems can provide at least 30% of the climate mitigation needed to limit warming to 1.5°C, Conservation International (CI) has set ambitious targets to realize the potential of Natural Climate Solutions (NCS) worldwide. CI's Carbon Finance (CF) unit within the Nature Finance Group (NFG) invests in NCS that help combat climate change by reducing deforestation and conserving and restoring critical ecosystems. These NCS solutions include the protection, enhanced management, and restoration of forests, rangelands, wetlands, and other natural systems.

The Carbon Finance team works across CI field programs and partner organizations to source and finance a strong pipeline of high-quality NCS carbon projects coupled with innovative financing designed to ensure long-term sustainability and private sector participation. The team taps the deep knowledge and technical expertise within CI to catalyze and improve the quality of gigatons of emission reductions and removals in the voluntary and compliance carbon markets. The CF team prioritizes impact through community engagement and benefit-sharing, biodiversity and environmental benefits, and the application of safeguards.

The Senior Carbon Technical Manager is an integral part of the CF team. The Senior Manager will be responsible for supporting the due diligence, development, and delivery of a carbon portfolio of investable NCS site- and jurisdictional-scale initiatives. This involves assessing early-stage pipeline opportunities, conducting project scoping, feasibility, and due diligence, performing field visits, and moving priority opportunities to full-scale development, including oversight of Project Documents and Monitoring Reports. The Senior Manager is also responsible for guiding projects through the validation and verification processes for certification standards such as the VCS and CCB, Gold Standard, the Mexico Forest Protocol, or other domestic and jurisdictional standards. The position includes project and budget planning and management, tracking and reporting on deliverables and project status.

The individual will work closely with a diverse team of CI staff members from around the world to apply their field experience, scientific knowledge, research skills, and innovative tools to evaluate project opportunities and guide them through design, development and certification processes. This position does not directly supervise staff.

Responsibilities

Carbon Project Development

  • Work with CI’s Regional Carbon Leads to provide Carbon Finance technical review, input, and guidance for projects undergoing scoping and feasibility assessment, and contribute to reports related to this effort. This will require desktop review and technical analysis of relevant documentation regarding project design, as well as direct engagement with project entities and conducting due diligence field visits, where needed. Technical analysis might include aspects such as assessing the agents and drivers of deforestation, key carbon project eligibility concepts, carbon accounting, governance, safeguards, and benefit-sharing frameworks, as well as risk mitigation, business models, etc.
  • For selected projects, provide Carbon Finance team project management oversight of the scoping and feasibility process, working with CI field programs, partners, and service providers. Ensure project information, workplans and deliverables are developed, completed, and shared with all relevant stakeholders, monitor progress, ensure alignment of the process and outcomes with NFG’s criteria and process on high-quality carbon projects, and identify corrective actions to resolve problems and ensure future project efficiencies.
  • For selected projects, act as a Carbon Finance team lead on the management and delivery of Project Documents (PD), Monitoring Reports (MRs), and other related documentation to ensure achievement of project validation and verification processes. This includes providing project entities with support on work planning, technical input and review, monitoring and evaluation, and overseeing the work of consultants, Validation & Verification Bodies (VVBs), and other service providers.
  • Work closely with, coordinate, collaborate, and communicate with all institutional carbon-related staff & teams (field and global programs) to ensure alignment with CI’s NCS and carbon crediting strategies and priorities.

Due Diligence

  • Lead desktop due diligence of the NCS project and jurisdictional opportunities. Evaluate projected carbon outcomes from emissions reductions and removals (ERRs) models to ensure targets are achievable given context and carbon crediting requirements.
  • Lead field-level due diligence of the NCS project and jurisdictional opportunities. Evaluate projected ERRs to ensure achievable targets given site conditions, local context, partner capacity, and carbon crediting requirements. Provide recommendations for improvement and summarize findings in coherent and well-substantiated written reports that will be shared with internal and external partners.
  • Review Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) protocols for NCS projects and conduct annual monitoring of reported results, including field-level site visits as required.
  • Develop and maintain CI’s relationships with project partners, consultants, and investors to enhance collaboration and partnership initiatives by continually providing useful technical inputs and identifying new opportunities for achieving CI’s global objectives in NCS.

Technical Innovation

  • Support the development of carbon and GIS tools, frameworks, and templates to streamline data gathering, analysis, and narrative elements of feasibility assessments, due diligence reports, PDs and MRs, including but not limited to emissions reduction or removal models, biodiversity and community monitoring, stakeholder engagement, workplans, theory of change models etc.
  • Provide technical assessment and comment on carbon market standards and methodology reviews that the Carbon Finance team will lead.
  • Support carbon project development training for CI countries, projects, and partners on a needs assessment basis.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is a full-time position. Work will be performed in a typical office environment, with potential for work from a home office.
  • Frequent travel within the Latin America region (and globally) will be required and will consist of approximately ~30% of the person’s time, often this will entail travel to remote locations with rustic conditions.
  • Flexibility in work schedule is required to accommodate time differences between the Arlington, VA office and international field offices in multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in forest management, forest ecology, natural resource management, climate science, or related fields.
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working on the technical development or due diligence of NCS projects.
  • Demonstrated experience with the application of NCS carbon accounting approaches and methodologies, including, but not limited to:
  • determining baseline and project emissions reductions & removals.
  • evaluating robustness of additionality arguments, non-permanence risk assessments, leakage estimates, and “business as usual” scenarios.
  • confirming the suitability of allometric equations, Biomass Expansion Factors, volumetric growth rate, wood density, root-to-shoot ratio, carbon fraction, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience with the validation and verification of NCS crediting projects (VCS, Gold Standard, CCBS, etc.), including the development of Project Documents (PDs), Monitoring Reports (MRs), and Validation and Verification Body (VVB) audits.
  • Excellent project management and coordination skills, and a strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent analytical skills with demonstrable experience in GIS, and Remote Sensing, including land-use change modeling.
  • Successful track record working with diverse team members, clients, stakeholders, and partners from different economic, cultural, religious, gender, and professional backgrounds in a range of countries or geographic contexts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience working with local partners, with an understanding of the on-the-ground realities and challenges of project development and delivery.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, multitask, set priorities, and deliver quality results.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to build on existing knowledge to develop new approaches.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field.
  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Demonstrated field-level experience in forest conservation, restoration of native ecosystems, improved forest management, or natural resource management.
  • Experience with training field teams on developing and implementing forest, carbon, and biodiversity monitoring plans.
  • Experience in carbon accounting for soils (e.g., peatlands, wetlands, and rangelands).
  • Experience communicating about REDD+ and other forest carbon finance mechanisms to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with or within the private sector on climate and NCS-related issues.
  • Experience working with indigenous peoples and traditional communities.
  • Experience working with government partners and supporting the development of policy.
  • Experience communicating about NCS and carbon finance mechanisms to technical and non-technical audiences.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Data Scientist (Brazil) Rio de Janeiro
description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

title: Associate Manager, Development Engineer Packaging
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate Manager, Development Engineer Packaging is a champion of new growth and expansion opportunities for I nternational Consumer Brands . Responsibilities include packaging development , feasibility assessment, and application of commercially available solutions to deliver new products . Additionally, you will contribute to the technical development & qualification of new or revised packaging materials & products.

The Associate Manager is accountable to work efficiently with internal and external partners, staying abreast of latest technology and trends within range of portfolio activity . You will participate on cross-functional teams and provide technical expertise to ensure that the key project objectives are present, applicable, and robust.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Bring curiosity and bias for action to assigned projects, contributing packaging technology options that fulfil consumer needs thru product design to enable SCJ’s business growth goals .

Collaborate with Procurement to identify right external partnerships ( i.e. 3PMs, suppliers) to leverage their expertise and stock available packaging options and development capabilities .

Demonstrate creativity in approach to identifying and evaluating new packaging materials and components that unlock speed in execution .

Provide expertise in areas of package design, material selection, performance characterization methods, and iterative prototyping to support test and learn model of NPD .

Lead outside vendors & design partners to assure the timely delivery of project milestones, including prototype samples, product qualification and scale-up activities .

Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in relevant categories for SCJ’s strategic growth businesses, including sustainability .

Collaborate with project manager and cross functional team to build project timeline, deliver key milestones, provide input on technical risks and mitigation plans.

Develop validation and line qualification plans, perform lab tests, and document results in technical reports .

Model R&D functional skills including effective communication, quality in design, regulatory compliance, product safety, and scientific rigor

Demonstrate ability to manage ambiguity & uncertainty across range of development activity, applying strategic thinking and business acumen for informed decision making .

Make SCJ a great place to work . Demonstrate care for fellow employees, our community, and the environment through mentoring and Community of Practice participation .

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Packaging or other relevant engineering disciplines (e.g., Mechanical, Material Science, etc.) and a minimum of 8 years of packaging development experience, or a master ’ s degree with at least 4 years relevant work experience .
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in Brazil .

PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS

  • The ideal candidate has a passion for sustainability and an interest in packaging solutions that maximize recyclability, recycled content, virgin plastic reduction, and minimizes negative environmental impacts of our products and materials selection.
  • Expertise in multiple packaging disciplines such as rigid plastics, dispensing systems, flexible materials, closures, manufacturing line requirements and plastic molding techniques.
  • Proven record of project team contribution on complex technical challenges, including anticipation and communication of technical risks and mitigation plans.
  • Strategic thinking and action to effectively navigate complex and/or ambiguous situations.
  • Applies product development methods and tools such as prioritization matrices, value mapping, FMEA, and experimental design to deliver against aligned product performance criteria .
  • Excellent communicator with experience presenting ideas with courage and conviction to management .
  • A natural tendency to investigate (tinker) on ways to solve new problems, or find alternative solutions on older challenges .
  • Ability to coach and mentor junior members of the organization .

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Position is Full-Time, regular business hours, Monday-Friday
  • Office work environment: Remote work available once a week for eligible employees
  • Travel up to 15%
  • This position is eligible for domestic relocation

BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, incentives and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

ABOUT US

SC JOHNSON IS A FIFTH-GENERATION FAMILY COMPANY BUILT ON THE SPIRIT OF OUR PEOPLE. We have been leading with purpose for over 130 years, building iconic brands that win the hearts and minds of consumers – such as Raid, Glade, OFF! , Mr.Músculo, Ziploc and more, in virtually every country around the world. Together, we are creating a better future – for the planet, for future generations and for every SCJ team member. Join our winning team of Wave Makers and Go Getters and help us write the next chapter in the SCJ story.

Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at .

title: TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO - MATERNIDADE MARIA AMÉLIA E CER CENTRO
description:
Job description

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.



Main responsibilities
  • Implementar e acompanhar a política de saúde e segurança no trabalho (SST), no setor do SESMT, da MATERNIDADE MARIA AMÉLIA E CER CENTRO. Realizar auditorias, acompanhar e avaliar a área, identificando vetores de doenças, variáveis de acidentes, qualidade de vida e meio ambiente. Promover ações educativas de caráter prevencionista.
  • Elaborar PPRA (Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais);
  • Realizar avaliações ambientais (Ruído, iluminação, temperatura dentre outros);
  • Elaborar estudos, fluxos, apresentações, relatórios, treinamentos de acordo com as Normas Regulamentadoras vigentes e a realidade regional;
  • Validar e receber documentos sobre segurança para as equipes terceirizadas;
  • Solicitar PPRA’s e demais documentações das empresas conveniadas a Instituição;
  • Realizar o levantamento das necessidades de equipamentos, processos e melhorias dos setores;
  • Solicitar materiais visando segurança dos empregados;
  • Realizar treinamentos e palestras relacionadas à Segurança no Trabalho à Base Administrativa e as Unidades;
  • Dar suporte técnico à todas as Unidades e Base Administrativa quanto as questões de segurança no trabalho;
  • Vistoriar a segurança nas Unidades, realizando o controle das condições dos sistemas de combate a incêndio, assim como solicitação de recarga, testes de mangueira e aquisições de acordo com as normas da ANVISA;
  • Elaborar relatórios e justificativas técnicas relatando erros ou desvios para solicitar ou recomendar melhorias dos processos de segurança e saúde no trabalho;
  • Acompanhar obras de reformas e serviços realizadas por empresas terceirizadas;
  • Enviar de relatório de investigação de ocorrência (RIO) para abertura de CAT (Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho);
  • Atualizar o fluxo de acidente biológico para investigação e posteriormente emissão da CAT (Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho);
  • Enviar o PPRA (Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais) à Área de Medicina do Trabalho para elaboração do PCMSO (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional);
  • Especificar, controlar e fiscalizar o uso e fornecimento de equipamentos de proteção individual adequados à eliminação, neutralização ou minimização do risco, assim como auditar o preenchimento correto da ficha de controle de uso do EPI - Equipamento de Proteção Individual;
  • Manusear e calibrar equipamentos utilizados nas medições ambientais com posterior emissão de relatórios;
  • Identificar fatores de risco de acidentes de trabalho e doenças profissionais, bem como especificar medidas de controle;
  • Prezar pelo cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras do MTE (Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego) e a legislação aplicável à Área de Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.


Requirements and skills
  • Possuir Curso de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Completo;
  • Possuir registro ativo no conselho de classe;
  • Possuir experiência de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Segurança no Trabalho, em hospitais ou maternidades
  • Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do rio;
  • Possuir disponibilidade total de horário de 7h as 16h ou de 12h as 21h - carga horária de 200h mensais / 40h semanais


Additional information
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira de 7h as 16h ou de 12h as 21h;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculos com grau de parentesco ou atividade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vinculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

Realizar atendimento de todas as solicitações de clientes, por meio da realização das tarefas de controle, processamento e apoio de atendimento, contribuindo para a satisfação do cliente, faturamento em empo hábil e indicadores de performance adequados para o departamento.

Tarefas Específicas:

  • Analisar as solicitações dos clientes independentemente da complexidade e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades específicas de viagem, com suporte técnico de outros Consultores e/ou Gestores.

Experiência Mínima Requerida para contratação / Formação Acadêmica:

  • Experiência em atividades administrativas/burocráticas.

  • Experiência prévia em revisão de processos e ações de melhoria contínua em Travel Services.
  • Experiência prévia treinamento de demais membros da equipe com menor senioridade.
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente/customer service.
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Direito, Relações Internacionais, Comércio Exterior ou Turismo.

Sobre nós

A CIBT é líder global no fornecimento de serviços de imigração e vistos para empresas e indivíduos, com mais de 1.500 profissionais especializados em imigração e vistos, advogados e consultores qualificados em migração, localizados em mais de 60 escritórios em 25 países. Com trinta anos de experiência, a CIBT é a principal prestadora de serviços para 75% das empresas da Fortune 500.

A CIBT oferece um conjunto abrangente de serviços sob duas marcas principais: a Newland Chase, uma subsidiária integral focada em estratégia de imigração global e serviços de consultoria para empresas em todo o mundo, e a CIBTvisas, líder de mercado em serviços de vistos de negócios e outros vistos de viagem para clientes corporativos e particulares. A CIBTvisas é o serviço líder global em vistos de viagem, com capacidade incomparável para obter vistos de negócios e outros vistos de viagem para empresas e particulares em todo o mundo de forma rápida, conveniente e segura.

title: Supervisor de Emergência Jr.
description:

O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

  • Supervisionar a empresa contratada para o serviço de Salvamento, de Atendimento Médico de Emergência, de Resgate e Combate a Incêndio, mantendo atualizados o levantamento e o suprimento das necessidades de recursos, equipamentos e materiais para emprego nas emergências aeronáuticas e não aeronáuticas;
  • Conhecer as normas gerais da organização e específicas de sua área, bem como normas e resoluções dos órgãos públicos, apoiando a coordenação e a gerência na elaboração de planos de contingência e na tomada de decisões estratégicas, dentre outras atividades.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em qualquer área de atuação;
  • CNH Categoria B ativa;
  • Conhecimento do sítio aeroportuário Pátio, Pista e/ou Terminais de passageiros, no mínimo 01 ano;

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
QA/QC Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.
  • Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.
  • Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.
  • Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.
  • Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.
  • Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.
  • Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.
  • Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.
  • Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.
  • Familiarity with MEP works is advantageous.
  • Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: Analista comercial
description:
Sobre a Lobie

A Lobie é a proptech que está revolucionando a gestão de imóveis para investidores. Nascemos de um grupo com mais de 80 anos de história e expertise no mercado imobiliário, combinando a solidez de uma das maiores construtoras do país com a capilaridade de uma administradora líder em gestão de condomínios.

Nossa missão é maximizar a rentabilidade de propriedades localizadas em pontos estratégicos através da locação de curto prazo (Short-Term Rental). Fazemos isso sob o lema

"Low Cost, High Yield" , garantindo uma gestão completa, transparente e altamente eficiente, com uma taxa de ocupação média superior a 85% em nossas mais de 750 unidades contratadas.

A Oportunidade: Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile)

Você já se perguntou o que acontece depois que um investidor compra um apartamento na planta? É aí que você entra.

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile) para ser a ponte essencial entre a aquisição do imóvel pelo investidor e o início da sua jornada de rentabilidade conosco. Esta não é uma venda tradicional; é o início de um relacionamento de longo prazo. Você será o rosto da Lobie no momento mais crucial: a ativação do ativo do nosso cliente.

Seu papel será garantir que cada investidor que adquire uma unidade em projetos parceiros entenda e adira aos nossos serviços de gestão e decoração, transformando um apartamento vazio em uma máquina de gerar receita.

Seus Desafios Serão:
  • Ativar a carteira de investidores que compram unidades nos empreendimentos parceiros, realizando o primeiro contato pós-compra.
  • Apresentar a tese de investimento da Lobie, demonstrando o potencial de rentabilidade através da nossa gestão especializada em locação de curta temporada.
  • Conduzir a venda do nosso produto
  • Lobie Decor , uma solução completa que inclui projeto de arquitetura, compra de itens com custo reduzido pela escala e gestão total da implementação, deixando a unidade pronta para operar.
  • Construir e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança com os investidores, garantindo uma experiência de onboarding fluida e positiva.
  • Realizar a gestão do funil de vendas e atividades no CRM, assegurando o acompanhamento de todos os leads.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de Operações e Marketing para garantir a passagem de bastão perfeita após a contratação dos serviços.
O que Buscamos em Você:
  • Paixão por pessoas e pela construção de relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar o "último metro" do processo comercial.
  • Vivência na área comercial ou de relacionamento com o cliente, preferencialmente B2C.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse pelo mercado imobiliário, de investimentos e/ou design de interiores é um grande diferencial.
Por que se Juntar à Lobie?
  • Impacto Real: Você verá o resultado direto do seu trabalho na receita da companhia e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.
  • Crescimento Acelerado: Faça parte de uma proptech em plena expansão, com o suporte de um dos grupos mais sólidos do setor imobiliário brasileiro.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Trabalhe em um ambiente que combina tecnologia, dados e uma abordagem moderna para um mercado tradicional.
  • Desenvolvimento: Oportunidade de aprender sobre investimentos, mercado imobiliário e vendas consultivas de alto valor.

Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida pelo desafio de transformar um negócio em um relacionamento de sucesso, queremos te conhecer!

title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

This is a TEMPORARY POSITION, for a 6 ~ 9 months (renewable) project.

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections
  • Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14)

Are you interested in this position? Send us your application!

EP2C Energy’s Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Policy

We prioritize adherence to HSE regulations to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. Our goal is to make a positive impact on the environment.

By joining our team, you will be expected to follow HSE procedures and best practices while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

Who Are We? – EP2C Energy

Founded in 2014, EP2C Energy is a fast-growing technical assistance company specializing in:

  • Energy (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear)
  • Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, Food Industries)

With an international presence — including subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia — we collaborate with major industry players and offer exciting career growth opportunities in France and worldwide.

At EP2C Energy , we value our employees’ expertise and are committed to their professional and personal development.

Joining EP2C Energy means becoming part of a dynamic team and an ambitious mission!

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers.   • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.

  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.

description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.

Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.
  • Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance.
  • Habilidade em análise de perdas e provisionamento.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos de capital e despesas operacionais.
  • Vivência com sistemas integrados, como: ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, etc.), BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.)
  • Análise estratégica e mindset de negócios.
  • Pacote Office avançado.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. title: General Foreman
description:

  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.

Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.
